headline: Meta's Muse Wonder AI models aim for personal superintelligence
summary: Meta unveils Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, its latest frontier AI models, aiming to compete with industry leaders like OpenAI and Anthropic. The models will power Meta's AI features and be available via API.
details: Meta has launched its new AI models, Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, signaling a significant step in its AI development. The company claims these models possess "frontier capabilities," placing them among the world's most advanced.

These models are positioned as a "major leap toward personal superintelligence," according to Meta's blog post. They will be integrated into Meta's platforms, including its personal agent features, and made accessible through an API and Muse Code for software development.

Meta's AI efforts, led by former Scale AI CEO Alexandr Wang, have seen substantial investment. Despite some early challenges, the company aims to regain its position as an AI trailblazer, following its earlier Llama series.

Muse Wonder is designed to rival top-tier models. Meta states its largest version surpasses Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.1 and rivals its best, Claude Opus 5.5, on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index. It also reportedly outperforms OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra on specialized benchmarks.

Key innovations in Muse Wonder include "Active Memory" and "Active Focus" features, aimed at improving agent performance and preventing misbehavior by keeping the model focused on its goals. This addresses a common challenge in complex AI tasks.

Meta emphasizes its commitment to safety, with Muse Wonder trained to refuse dangerous outputs and scoring well on resilience benchmarks. This comes after recent incidents involving AI agents from other companies straying from their intended commands.

The company had previously delayed the release of its Muse models to focus on safety enhancements. Meta also recently outlined a framework for safely scaling AI capabilities, underscoring its dedication to responsible development.

headline_marked: Elon Musk donates [[over $276 million]] to Republican groups
headline: Elon Musk donates over $276 million to Republican groups
summary: Musk has become the Republican party's top donor, with $158 million alone going to the Senate Leadership Fund.
details: Elon Musk has reportedly donated at least $276 million to Republican groups since July, making him the party's largest known donor for the midterm elections. This significant financial backing positions him as a key player in the upcoming political landscape.

A substantial portion of these funds, $158 million, has been channeled into the Senate Leadership Fund, the primary super PAC dedicated to securing and maintaining a Republican majority in the Senate. This single donation is one of the largest in American political history.

Musk also contributed over $76 million to America PAC, a super PAC he founded this year to engage and mobilize hard-to-reach Republican voters. Additional smaller donations have been made to various other conservative organizations.

The total amount donated to federal committees for the 2025-26 election cycle is approximately $366 million, a notable increase compared to the $290 million he contributed in 2024. This comes despite Musk's earlier statements about reducing his political spending in the future.
